inventory.description: Pure, host-testable products of Packages/VisualCore: VisualCoreMath, VisualCoreSimulation, VisualCoreScenes, VisualCoreShaderSource, VisualCoreEffectsGraph, VisualCoreDiagnostics, VisualCoreAudioDSP, VisualCorePersistence, VisualCoreParameters, VisualCoreExperience (+ VisualCoreTestSupport for test targets). iOS products of Packages/VisualCoreRendering: VisualCoreRendering, VisualCoreEffects, VisualCoreUI, VisualCoreAudio (links AVFAudio), VisualCoreAutomation, VisualCoreExperienceHost. VisualCoreAudioDSP holds only AudioDSPInfo.version and VisualCoreAudio only AudioInfo.version (checked 2026-11-14): no capture, decoding, ring buffer, FFT, bands, RMS or onset code exists in any product. Experience targets live in Packages/ExperiencesCreative (A01-A05 today); A06 targets go to a new Packages/ExperiencesCreative (package map; corrected in A06-P01) package created in A06-P01. Dependency rules enforced by scripts/check_dependencies.py; public surface recorded in docs/api/visualcore-public-api.txt.

RenderHost (@MainActor) owns the EGL display, context and surfaces over ANGLE's Metal backend (EGLDisplayProvider), the CAMetalLayer RenderView, the FrameScheduler and context generations; pause/resume, recreateContext, renderOffscreen and destroy; scenes implement RenderScene setup/resize/render/teardown. All GL work runs on the main thread. Audio capture and analysis must never touch GL: audio callbacks write a bounded buffer, analysis runs off the realtime thread, and only finished feature values cross to the main thread at the frame boundary. VisualCore Music Lab adds no EGL or GL context of its own.

ResourceRegistry creates buffers, textures, programs and render targets under a ResourceBudget and rejects stale handles after a generation change; Texture.upload(rgba:) and RenderTarget.upload(rgbaFloats:) replace texel data. ShaderProgram (scalar, vector, vec3-array and matrix uniforms), ShaderBundle and ShaderLibrary (#include expansion with line maps) compile bundled GLSL; the vc/ library holds color, field, hash, noise, palette and sdf helpers. FullScreenShaderScene feeds u_time, u_resolution, u_seed, u_palette and named scalar parameters; it binds no texture. The effects graph (VisualCoreEffectsGraph + VisualCoreEffects) chains copy, colorMatrix, blur, bloom, distort, composite, feedback and flashLimit passes.

ExperienceSession opens, checkpoints, closes and recovers an Experience on one RenderHost, applies the quality level (QualityGovernor over the experience's QualityProfile) and memory/scene-phase events; ExperienceShell adapts an ExperiencePresenter (scene, controls) to Experience; ExperienceCore is the GPU-free state; ExperienceStorage is the per-experience sandbox; the one app registers experiences in ExperienceRegistry (A06 joins in A06-P01; scripts/check_experience_packages.py forbids unregistered targets). The app's project.yml has no NSMicrophoneUsageDescription today.

XcodeGen spec project.yml for the one app (target VisualCore), package schemes via scripts/xcodebuild_package.py, app tests via scripts/xcodebuild_app.py, and scripts/release_check.py: 83 named steps listed by --list on 2026-11-14 (shared checks, package and app builds/tests, per-experience verification of A01-A05, release audits of the one app incl. app-usage-descriptions, reference regression steps).

VisualCore Music Lab owns its domain (MusicPreset, scene choice, ReactiveMapping choices and defaults, copy, accessibility metric phrasing), curated presets and UI under Packages/ExperiencesCreative/VisualCoreMusicLab/ (Core GPU-free, Experience UIKit/GPU; package created in A06-P01). VisualCore owns reusable audio machinery: sources, permission, interruption handling (VisualCoreAudio), ring buffer, FFT, bands, RMS, peak, onset, smoothing, demo signal and feature-to-parameter mapping (VisualCoreAudioDSP), plus shaders, effects, quality and persistence (constitution Principle II, Auto-Creator.md section 13). ProjectM stays in the harness.

Reference pinned at d93edd1, read-only; scripts/run_reference_baseline.py lists the ordered reference steps; scripts/check_reference_clean.py checks the submodule; the 7 release-check steps run in two chunks via release_check.py --only (docs/apps/visualcore-music-lab/regression-baseline.md).

matrix.capability: Audio-reactive parameters: per-frame scalar uniforms driven by audio features within declared ranges
matrix.notes: Named scalar uniforms and ranged parameter definitions exist and are tested (FullScreenShaderSceneTests, VisualCoreParametersTests), but nothing turns an audio feature into a parameter value. G-AUDIOMAP: ReactiveMapping (feature, gain, attack, release, clamp, target parameter) applied at the frame boundary. Built in A06-P03.

matrix.capability: Shader effects: bundled full-screen fragment programs with uniforms, palette and time
matrix.notes: Used by A01-A05; vc/color, vc/noise, vc/palette, vc/hash, vc/field and vc/sdf include files ship in the VisualCoreRendering bundle.

matrix.capability: Post-processing: validated effect graph (bloom, blur, colour matrix, distort, feedback, composite) with a flash limiter
matrix.notes: EffectScene wraps any RenderScene; tested by VisualCoreEffectsTests (PassPixelTests, EffectRendererTests). Beat-driven bloom/feedback parameters come through G-AUDIOMAP; Reduce Flashing inserts the flashLimit pass.

matrix.capability: Animation: tweens, timelines, easing and a scene clock with Reduce Motion
matrix.notes: Host-tested (VisualCoreSimulationTests, VisualCoreMathTests). Audio-time smoothing is not animation and belongs to G-AUDIODSP.

matrix.capability: Scene and preset management: parameter schemas, seeded presets, named library, scene switching
matrix.notes: Preset values and palette are generic; a MusicPreset (scene, palette, mappings, schema version) is experience domain on top of these (A06-P04).

matrix.capability: Microphone live input: AVAudioEngine input tap delivering PCM frames to a bounded buffer
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 01; journey 1; manual section 6 algorithm 1
matrix.notes: VisualCoreAudio holds only AudioInfo.version; no audio capture exists in any VisualCore product (the closest consumer is the placeholder module itself). G-AUDIOSOURCE: a microphone source on public AVFAudio APIs behind the one source interface. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Microphone permission gate: record-permission state, request, denied/restricted handling and an honest usage string
matrix.notes: No permission model exists and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is absent from project.yml (checked 2026-11-14). G-MICPERMISSION: a testable permission state machine in VisualCoreAudio (AVAudioApplication record permission); the usage string is added by A06-P01 and checked by app-usage-descriptions. The demo signal works without permission. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Local file audio the app can legally decode: a user-chosen file decoded on device to PCM
matrix.notes: No decoding exists. G-FILESOURCE: an AVAudioFile-based file source (user-picked through the system document picker, security-scoped, read only, never copied off device) with bounded length, truncated/unsupported-format rejection, behind the same source interface. No bundled third-party music. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Audio source interface: one protocol for microphone, file and demo with a common mono float format and sample rate
matrix.source: manual section 4 AudioSourceController; section 6 AudioSource schema
matrix.notes: G-AUDIOSOURCE: AudioSource kind (microphone, localFile, demo), format negotiation, downmix to mono, start/stop, published status; pure parts (format, downmix) in VisualCoreAudioDSP, AVFAudio parts in VisualCoreAudio. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Bounded PCM ring buffer: single-producer/single-consumer, no allocation or locks in the realtime callback
matrix.notes: No ring buffer exists (the closest consumer is A02's capped SplatQueue). G-RINGBUFFER: a fixed-capacity SPSC float ring in VisualCoreAudioDSP with overrun counting and a read-latest window, host-tested. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: RMS and peak levels per analysis window (linear and dBFS)
matrix.notes: G-AUDIODSP: RMS, peak and dBFS with silence floor and NaN/Inf rejection. Built in A06-P02.

matrix.capability: Windowed FFT spectrum and logarithmic band energies
matrix.notes: G-AUDIODSP: Hann-windowed real FFT (Accelerate vDSP, public API) of power-of-two size, magnitude spectrum and a configurable log-spaced band set, computed outside the realtime callback. Built in A06-P02.

matrix.capability: Spectral flux, onset and smoothed beat-energy signals with attack/release smoothing
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 02; manual section 6 algorithm 3; FeatureSmoother
matrix.notes: G-AUDIODSP: spectral flux, adaptive-threshold onset and beat energy, and a time-stamped attack/release smoother that is frame-rate independent. Built in A06-P02.

matrix.capability: Silent demo signal: deterministic synthetic PCM for offline testing, clearly labelled, no audio output
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 06; domain rule (label demo vs real input)
matrix.notes: SeededRandom gives determinism but no signal generator exists. G-DEMOSIGNAL: a seeded generator (tones, noise bursts, beat pattern) producing PCM through the source interface, never played to the speaker, identical frames for a seed. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Audio interruption, route change and media-services reset recovery
matrix.notes: ExperienceSession handles scene phase and memory, not audio session events. G-INTERRUPTION: an interruption/route/reset state machine in VisualCoreAudio driven by AVAudioSession notifications, resuming only when allowed, falling back to the demo signal or a paused state with a message. Built in A06-P04.

matrix.capability: Source/status indicator: active source, permission, live/demo/paused/interrupted label and level, announced to VoiceOver
matrix.notes: Announcement and message views exist; the observable source status they would show does not. G-AUDIOSOURCE provides the status model; the indicator view and copy are experience-owned. Built in A06-P01.

matrix.capability: Audio-to-parameter mapping: feature, gain, attack, release, clamp and target uniform, editable and persisted
matrix.source: manual section 6 ReactiveMapping; AudioReactiveMapping; journey 3 calibrate gain
matrix.notes: G-AUDIOMAP: a Codable, validated ReactiveMapping in VisualCoreAudioDSP that maps a time-stamped feature to a ParameterDefinition's range at the frame boundary; reused by the other audio experiences (A07, A08). Built in A06-P03.

matrix.capability: Signal data in shaders: per-frame spectrum/waveform upload to a small texture sampled by a full-screen fragment program
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 03; manual section 6 render stage 3, 4
matrix.notes: Textures can be created and uploaded, but FullScreenShaderScene binds no texture and ShaderProgram has no float-array setter. G-SIGNALTEXTURE: a full-screen scene input that uploads up to N float samples per frame (one row, linear filtering) and binds it as u_signal, rebuilt after context loss.

matrix.capability: Bars scene: spectrum bars drawn as batched 2D primitives
matrix.notes: Rects in one batched draw (PrimitiveRendererTests); band values come from G-AUDIODSP.

matrix.capability: Waveform rings scene: closed waveform outlines around a centre
matrix.notes: Line primitives (up to 256-point polygons) draw rings of waveform segments; a smoother shader variant uses G-SIGNALTEXTURE (M18).

matrix.capability: 3D-ish responsive geometry: depth-correct lit meshes transformed by mapped features
matrix.notes: Closed by A05 (DepthMeshPassTests); per-item model matrix and colour carry the audio response; no per-frame mesh rebuild is needed.

matrix.capability: Presets and local persistence: versioned documents, named library, per-experience storage
matrix.notes: Migrations, size caps and quarantine exist and are tested; no audio is ever persisted, only settings and mappings.

matrix.capability: Accessibility text metrics: level, band and beat values as text for VoiceOver and without animation or colour
matrix.source: v0.1 feature 05; manual section 3 legibility rule
matrix.notes: Native labelled controls and announcements exist; the metric phrasing (rounded dBFS, band names, rate-limited announcements) is experience copy. G-A11YMETRICS (app-local).

matrix.capability: Accessibility: Reduce Motion, Reduce Flashing (beat flashes limited), legible native controls
matrix.notes: Beat-driven brightness must pass through the flashLimit pass when Reduce Flashing is in force.

matrix.capability: Still export of the current scene
matrix.notes: Stills render the frozen feature values of the moment; no audio or video recording (later-stage idea, not MVP).

matrix.capability: Render-quality tiers and automatic quality governor
matrix.notes: Tested in SessionQualityTests; render resolution and effect passes follow the level.

matrix.capability: Audio and render performance budget: analysis cost per frame, FFT size and band count by quality level, frame pacing
matrix.notes: Frame pacing and quality levels exist; nothing bounds analysis work or maps it to a level. G-AUDIOBUDGET: an analysis configuration (FFT size, hop, band count) per quality level with a measured per-window cost bound.

matrix.capability: Render host lifecycle: context loss, resize, background, memory warning
matrix.source: manual section 6 rendering lifecycle; state transitions
matrix.notes: RenderHostTests and CleanupSweepTests; audio sources stop on background independently of GL (G-INTERRUPTION).

matrix.capability: Hosting as an experience of the one app (session open/suspend/resume/close, scene phase, memory)
matrix.notes: A06 registers in A06-P01 with its four targets in Packages/ExperiencesCreative (package map; corrected in A06-P01).

gaps.test: Host tests of the pure format/downmix part (VisualCoreAudioDSP) and simulator tests of the source state machine with an injected engine: start/stop/restart, status transitions idle -> running -> stopped/failed, mono downmix of stereo frames, demo and microphone behind the same interface; no allocation in the tap closure (measured with an allocation counter in tests)
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: VisualCoreAudio holds only AudioInfo.version; every audio experience (A06-A08) needs the same source interface and status.

gaps.test: Unit tests with an injected permission provider: undetermined -> granted/denied, denied never starts capture and offers the demo signal, a revoked permission stops a running source; app-usage-descriptions passes with NSMicrophoneUsageDescription present
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: no permission model and no usage string exist; the gate is generic for microphone-using experiences.

gaps.test: Simulator tests with generated fixture files written at test time: decodes PCM of the expected length and rate, rejects truncated, empty, oversize and unsupported files with a typed error, stops at end of file and loops on request
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: no decoding exists; file input is shared with the other audio experiences.

gaps.test: Host tests: FIFO order across wrap-around, overrun drops oldest and counts it, read-latest window of N samples, concurrent producer/consumer stress of a bounded number of iterations without loss beyond counted overruns, capacity validation
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: no realtime-safe buffer exists; any audio analysis needs one.

gaps.test: Host tests: identical samples for one seed, different for another, bounded amplitude, known RMS of the tone part and beat positions detectable by G-AUDIODSP; never routed to audio output (no output node in the graph)
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: offline/permission-free use and deterministic fixtures need a generator in the DSP product.

gaps.test: Host fixture tests: RMS/peak of sine, square and silence within 1e-6; FFT of a pure tone peaks in the expected bin with Hann leakage bounds; band energies sum consistently; onset detected on synthetic clicks within one hop; smoother attack/release time constants independent of frame rate; NaN/Inf input rejected
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: VisualCoreAudioDSP holds only AudioDSPInfo.version; analysis is generic for all audio experiences (Accelerate vDSP is a public API).

gaps.test: Host tests: mapping applies gain, attack, release and clamp into a ParameterDefinition range, rejects unknown features and non-finite values, Codable round trip with schema version, deterministic output for a recorded feature sequence
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: no feature-to-parameter binding exists; the mapping is reusable by A07 and A08.

gaps.test: Simulator tests: a full-screen program samples an uploaded ramp signal and offscreen pixels match within a stated tolerance; per-frame upload reuses one texture; context recreation rebuilds it with no stale handle
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: FullScreenShaderScene binds no texture; signal-driven shaders are generic for audio and data experiences. Re-phased to 5 in A06-P03: the three scenes draw with the host primitive and mesh renderers and need no signal texture.

gaps.test: Unit tests with injected session notifications: interruption began pauses the source and marks status interrupted, ended with shouldResume resumes, route change (headphones removed) and media-services reset rebuild the engine, background stops capture; no crash or stuck state across a scripted sequence
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: ExperienceSession knows scene phase but not audio session events; every audio experience needs the same recovery.

gaps.test: Core tests: metric text for given features (rounded dBFS, dominant band name, beat yes/no) and rate-limited announcements; UI test that the metrics are exposed as accessibility values without animation
gaps.justification: Phrasing of level, band and beat text is experience copy over VisualCore's AnnouncementSink and native controls; nothing generic is missing.

gaps.test: Host tests: each quality level maps to a valid analysis configuration; a short measured run of the analysis per window stays within the stated per-window bound (asserted locally, extrapolated on CI)
gaps.justification: Found in A06-P00: quality levels and pacing exist but analysis cost is unbounded and not tied to a level.

traceability.item: v0.1 feature 01 - microphone permission-gated live input and local file audio
v0.1 feature 02 - RMS, peak, FFT spectrum and smoothed beat energy
v0.1 feature 03 - three scenes: bars, waveform rings, 3D-ish responsive geometry
v0.1 feature 04 - source/status indicator and audio-interruption recovery
v0.1 feature 05 - parameter presets, local persistence and accessibility text metrics
v0.1 feature 06 - silent demo signal for offline testing
cross-cutting: still export, quality tiers, performance budget, lifecycle, one-app hosting

negative.rule: No EGL display, context, surface or GL path of its own and no second renderer; all drawing goes through VisualCore's RenderHost on OpenGL ES -> ANGLE -> Metal
negative.source: manual rendering invariant; constitution; CLAUDE.md rule 4

negative.rule: No ProjectM types, engine or presets and no MilkDrop/ProjectM engine code reused as the implementation; the experience is not a ProjectM clone
negative.source: manual section 2 explicit non-goals; section 4 ownership policy; CLAUDE.md rule 12

negative.rule: No networking, accounts, analytics, tracking or advertising; microphone and file audio are processed in memory on the device and never recorded, uploaded or persisted
negative.source: manual section 2 explicit non-goals; section 3; CLAUDE.md rule 3

negative.rule: No capture of other apps' or system audio (for example streaming services); only the microphone, user-chosen local files and the demo signal through public Apple APIs
negative.source: manual section 2 explicit non-goals; domain-specific engineering rule; CLAUDE.md rule 12

negative.rule: No measurement, calibration, hearing or health claims: levels and spectra are artistic visualisations, not a sound level meter
negative.source: manual section 1 product hypothesis; spec FR-A06-006

negative.rule: The demo signal is always labelled as demo and never presented as live input; it is never played to the speaker
negative.source: manual domain-specific engineering rule; v0.1 feature 06

negative.rule: No bundled third-party music or purchased/generated media; visuals are code
negative.source: CLAUDE.md rule 4; manual section 5 file creation policy

negative.rule: No fork or copy of VisualCore, ANGLE or projectm-ios and no standalone app target; generic audio needs become VisualCore gaps

reasons: The render host, shader path, effects graph, animation, presets, persistence, export, quality and accessibility exist with tests: 13 of 29 rows are available, and the three scenes can be drawn with PrimitiveRenderer and DepthMeshPass today.

Audio is buildable inside VisualCore's planned products on public APIs (AVFAudio/AVFoundation for sources, permission and session events; Accelerate vDSP for the FFT): VisualCoreAudio already links AVFAudio and VisualCoreAudioDSP is a pure, host-testable target, so no second backend, fork, private API or networking is needed.

All eleven gaps are additive and owned: G-AUDIOSOURCE, G-MICPERMISSION, G-FILESOURCE (VisualCoreAudio, P01), G-RINGBUFFER and G-DEMOSIGNAL (VisualCoreAudioDSP, P01), G-AUDIODSP (P02), G-AUDIOMAP and G-SIGNALTEXTURE (P03), G-INTERRUPTION (P04), G-AUDIOBUDGET and the app-local G-A11YMETRICS (P05).

VisualCore Music Lab stays unregistered until A06-P01 creates Packages/ExperiencesCreative (package map; corrected in A06-P01) with its four targets and real domain rules, so the experience package check and the one app are unchanged.
A06-P01 starts with G-RINGBUFFER, G-DEMOSIGNAL and the source interface, so the permission-free demo path works before the microphone path.
